items.title: Night Wrap: Tuesday, November 3
items.html:
Tri-City scored 24 goals, Swift Current scored 12 in one game, and the eliminated Newfoundland Regiment beat the first-place team in the QMJHL West. That's 93 games, 652 goals, 19 overtimes and 8 shutouts, with one week left in the regular season.

The headline: Tri-City's top line

The Tri-City Americans won 8-3 at Moose Jaw, 6-3 at Brandon and 10-0 over Regina. Crocoshoe scored 11 goals: four, four and three. I Hxntz I scored 10, six of them against Regina, and Nash--61 had 13 assists. That line accounted for 23 of Tri-City's 24 goals. Tri-City finished the week 8-0-1.

Swift Current 12, Penticton 1

Swift Current led 6-0 after one period and 10-0 after two. scorezyy had 5 goals and 5 assists, GFLR 4 and 4, and sepoL1083 3 and 4. Swift Current outshot Penticton 32-8. An hour earlier, Penticton had beaten Lethbridge 4-1.

Three for three

  • Halifax Mooseheads: 6-2 over Quebec, 5-0 at Drummondville and 3-0 at Victoriaville. DeadlyBeren made 31 saves on 33 shots and posted both shutouts.
  • Rimouski Oceanic: 6-1 at Victoriaville, 3-1 over Gatineau and 7-2 over Moncton. MrNoOvO scored four against Moncton, and bilodxau had 1 goal and 4 assists.
  • Sault Ste. Marie Greyhounds: 5-4 over North Bay, 4-2 at Oshawa and 9-1 over Sudbury. MJ l19l had 3 goals and 6 assists against Sudbury, 15 points on the night.
  • Spokane, Medicine Hat, Edmonton, Red Deer, Kelowna, Sarnia, Saginaw, Cape Breton and Baie-Comeau also went 3-0.

Big games

  • Erie 10, Oshawa 0. HortenseOwl4948 had 5 goals and 4 assists, and Canate stopped all 9 shots.
  • Newfoundland 5, Drummondville 2. YDK_Marshall scored all five Newfoundland goals. Drummondville, first in the QMJHL West, lost all three games on the night.
  • Medicine Hat 8, Kamloops 7 (OT). Medicine Hat led 5-1 after two periods. Kamloops scored six in the third to tie it 7-7, and Medicine Hat won in overtime. Borzy0430 had 5 goals and 2 assists.
  • Rouyn-Noranda 4, Moncton 3. Moncton outshot them 35-13, and SweetDWilly21 made 32 saves.
  • Vancouver 4, Prince Albert 1. piffywiffy. had 3 goals and 1 assist. Prince Albert lost twice on the night and is now two points ahead of Medicine Hat for first in the WHL Eastern.

Calgary

The Hitmen lost 3-1 at Kelowna, beat Vancouver 3-2 in overtime, and won 7-2 at Everett. gtcoop73 had 2 goals and 8 assists, l Setty l 3 goals and 6 assists, and l danks l 5 goals and 2 assists. Those three scored 10 of Calgary's 11 goals on the night.

The race below the line

Lethbridge, Swift Current, Chilliwack and Calgary all went 2-1. Nothing moved: Lethbridge is fifth in the WHL Eastern with 63 points, Swift Current and Chilliwack have 61, and Calgary has 60.

Rough nights

Regina lost 10-0 at Tri-City and finished the week 0-9. Everett, Gatineau, Oshawa, Sudbury, Saint John, Quebec, Wenatchee and Drummondville also went 0-3.

items.html:

items.title: Week 4 features: three nights, three turnarounds
items.html:
1. Gatineau: from five straight losses to seven straight wins

On Sunday the Gatineau Olympiques went 0-4: 1-0 to Medicine Hat, 3-2 to Penticton, 3-0 to Kitchener and 6-0 to Wenatchee. Then they opened Monday with a 5-1 loss to Owen Sound. Five straight losses, and 26 points after Sunday.

They haven't lost since. Gatineau closed Monday with three one-goal wins (4-3 over Victoria, 4-3 over North Bay, 2-1 over Sudbury) and swept Tuesday: 3-0 over Ottawa, 4-3 in overtime over Brantford, 3-2 in overtime over WHL West leader Spokane, and 5-3 over Seattle. That's seven straight, the longest active streak in the league. Gatineau has 40 points (19-18), 7th in the QMJHL West.

Tuesday's names: Baw x 22 with 8 goals and 10 points, and xPirateqc in goal, 51 saves on 59 shots, 4-0, with the shutout of Ottawa.

The Oshawa Generals didn't win on Sunday (0-3-1, including a 7-0 loss to Victoriaville) and lost their first two Monday games, to Regina 2-1 and Sherbrooke 4-1. That was six games without a win.

Then: 1-0 over Medicine Hat and 4-1 over Saskatoon to finish Monday, and a Tuesday sweep: 3-2 in overtime over Edmonton, 5-2 over Halifax, 6-5 over Seattle and 5-3 over Saint John. Six straight, and 12 points in two nights (from 20 to 32). On Tuesday Philartmony had 15 points (5 G, 10 A) and kworker84 14 (7 G, 7 A). Oshawa is still 10th in the OHL East at 14-21, so the climb is just getting started.

The Prince George Cougars went 1-3 on Sunday and 2-2 on Monday and were 7th in the WHL West with 36 points. Tuesday they went 4-0, outscored opponents 23-6, and finished the night 3rd with 44 points, five straight wins in all.
